data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 落日海滩·水着狂阶收刀回眸
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 落日海滩·水着狂阶收刀回眸】落日余晖洒满海浪翻滚的金色沙滩，换上狂野黑色比基尼泳装的黑贞潇洒地将漆黑日本刀收入鞘中，海风吹卷着她短俏的白发。她回过头冲你挑眉一笑——「哼，区区几只海怪也敢打扰我们的假期？今晚的烧烤食材已经解决了，快去生火！」
data.promptProse: Jeanne Alter finishes sheathing her katana, one hand remaining on the hilt and the other steadying the black scabbard as she looks back with a raised eyebrow. Her black summer swimsuit and loose beach wrap frame the completed action in the medium portrait. Wind stirs short silver hair above the sand, waves receding behind. Golden-hour light traces the closed scabbard and wrap folds, leaving soft shade beneath her hands.
data.action: 刀已入鞘，一手留在刀柄一手稳住鞘身，转头朝同行者挑眉微笑
